Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The agent prematurely asserted having usable search results and then attempted to extract data by using an inappropriate method (scrape_wikipedia_tables) on a PDF URL. This mismatched tool choice and lack of direct verification of the primary source led to access errors and set the process into a repetitive search loop instead of extracting the required items from the 1959 document, which ultimately prevented calculating the superseded percentage.
